acceptance.condition: Write a receipt with a concise architecture map, risks, and a prioritized replacement sequence. Do not modify project files.
acceptance.how_checked: AUDIT.md contains the architecture map, six risks/findings, stable contracts, and six-step sequence. git diff -- prototype showed pre-existing/project-shared changes in CIWS/weapon assets, MainLab, match director, library, operations setup, visual builder, and a Blender tool; this audit used only read commands plus writes under its task directory.

findings: Navigation.ROUTES is not authoritative in practice: it omits Livery, ModularHullBuilder, and TerrainSculpt while MainMenu exposes those destinations, and several surfaces direct-call change_scene_to_file.
The main Design Lab selected-module interaction is ModuleActionRing via TweakCalloutManager; UIRadialMenu is a separate ModularHullBuilder interaction. Do not remove or conflate them.
SystemLayer OBJECTIVES is not implemented; it issues a warning. Records is not exposed by the implemented Main Menu group map.
Battle HUD is intentionally separate from the out-of-match token/theme/3D chrome system and is already a consolidation boundary.
assumptions_made: HullBuilder, ModularHullBuilder, and TerrainSculpt were included because MainMenu exposes them as player-selectable destinations, even though they may also serve authoring/development use.
Project documentation was treated only as corroborating evidence; concrete ownership/routes were derived from scripts and scenes.
